name: Papercut
tagline: Layered cut-paper craft — warm sand, terracotta, teal
technique: Layered paper-cut illustration: stacked sheets of colored craft paper with crisp cut edges, soft shadows between the layers and visible paper fiber — a warm, handmade depth.
avoid: tech that wants to look sharp

plates.accept: Layered hills + road + house + sun; upper-left plain; no text.
Paper-cut envelope with letter and heart; no text on the letter.
Paper-cut tree on coins; no text.
Layered mountain strips only; nothing else.
One paper-cut lightbulb on flat pure magenta; no shadow on the background.
One paper-cut calendar on flat pure magenta; no digits.
One paper-cut trophy on flat pure magenta.

generate.base: A layered paper-cut illustration of {subject}: stacked sheets of colored craft paper in sand, terracotta, mustard and teal, crisp cut edges, soft shadows between the layers, visible paper fiber. No faces.
generate.spot: A layered paper-cut illustration of {subject}: mustard, terracotta and teal paper, stacked layers with crisp cut edges and soft shadows between the layers, visible paper fiber, floating with no background sheet.
generate.rules: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature anywhere in the image.
